data.description:
## Context / Problem
`src/rebar/llm/criteria/overlay.py:373-390 _activation_map` accepts `"activate": ["project.x"]` (legacy) alongside the canonical `{"project.x": ["plan_review"]}`; the repo's own overlay uses the canonical form, but client projects' `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` files may use the list form. Operator ruling: keep accepting it, warn. No `logging` or `warnings` idiom exists in `criteria/` (grep: zero). The repo's single deprecation channel is `_deprecations.warn_deprecated` (`src/rebar/_deprecations.py:17-21,386-413`; `tests/unit/test_deprecation_registry.py:134` fails any raw `.warning("… is deprecated")`), emitting `logger.warning` on the caller's module logger. `effective_criteria` has 17 src call sites, so the emission rides the existing `(gate_key, repo_root, overlay-signature)` `lru_cache` at `overlay.py:333` to fire once per overlay content. `_deprecations.py:109-111` also carries a stale NOTE saying the single-pass engine stays, which the demo-retirement story (chivalrous-consistent-tigermoth) makes false. Cites are on origin/main 2e81cb9767c1.

## Approach
1. `_deprecations.py` `_ENTRIES`: add `_scheduled("cfg", "criteria_routing.json 'activate' id-list", "the {\"activate\": {\"<id>\": [\"plan_review\"|\"code_review\"]}} mapping form")`; the message renders as "criteria_routing.json 'activate' id-list is deprecated; use the {...} mapping form (scheduled for removal in v1.0.0)."
2. `overlay.py`: `import logging`; `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)`; in `_effective_routing_cached` right after `overlay = _load_overlay(rr_arg)` / `if overlay is not None:` (`:340-341`) add `if isinstance(overlay.get("activate"), list): warn_deprecated("cfg:criteria_routing.json 'activate' id-list", logger=logger)`. `_activation_map` unchanged.
3. Rewrite the stale NOTE at `_deprecations.py:109-111` to record the engine's removal by the demo-retirement story.
4. `docs/plan-review-gate.md:363-366` add one sentence after the example: "A bare id list (`\"activate\": [\"project.x\"]`) is still accepted and infers the gate from the routing maps, but logs a deprecation warning."

## Scope
The files above. Out of scope: any change to `_activation_map` semantics or the other `CriteriaError` paths.

## Testing
Add to `tests/unit/test_criteria_overlay.py`: `test_legacy_activate_list_warns_once(caplog)` (overlay with the list form; `caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger="rebar.llm.criteria.overlay")`; call `effective_criteria(root, gate_key="plan_review")` twice and assert exactly one record containing "criteria_routing.json 'activate' id-list is deprecated") and `test_canonical_activate_mapping_does_not_warn` (zero records). Existing list-form fixtures (`test_criteria_overlay.py:77,134,183`) stay valid. `tests/unit/test_deprecation_registry.py` well-formedness tests cover the new row.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `python -c "from rebar._deprecations import REGISTRY; print(REGISTRY[\"cfg:criteria_routing.json 'activate' id-list\"].remove_in)"` prints `v1.0.0`.
- [ ] The two new tests pass and `tests/unit/test_deprecation_registry.py::test_no_raw_deprecation_emissions` passes.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0` (a registry row is none of the seven censused kinds).
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Warn once on the legacy activate id-list form in .rebar/criteria_routing.json
